Question #: 1.Title: Exam F5CAB5 topic 1 question 11 discussion - ExamTopics

content.value: During a user reported outage for a single virtual server, a BIG-IP Administrator checks the status of the configured pool associated with the virtual server and sees the status icons for the pool members are black.
What does the black icon indicate?
A. The pool members have been forced offline.
B. The pool members' configuration is missing either a port or an IP address.
C. There is no monitoring configured for the pool members and therefore no status is available.
D. A monitor has marked a pool member down.
